settings.xgp_source_hint: Off by default. Fetches third-party WGS/PGS path mappings at runtime. The upstream repository currently declares no open-source license, and availability and accuracy are not guaranteed.
settings.xgp_source_review: Review upstream project, license status, and terms
settings.xgp_source_consent_message: This feature requires you to review and accept the applicable third-party license status and terms before it is enabled.
settings.xgp_source_consent_detail: The XgpSaveTools repository currently declares no open-source license. Enabling this option does not grant additional rights. OpenGameSave will fetch its registry at runtime and use only package/save-path mappings; XgpSaveTools handlers are not integrated. The source may change, stop working, or contain inaccurate data, and availability is not guaranteed.
settings.xgp_source_fetch_failed: The source is enabled, but it could not be fetched. OpenGameSave will try again later.
settings.xgp_source_change_failed: Could not change the experimental XgpSaveTools source setting.

main.title: OpenGameSave
main.sync_description: Manage backup storage and sync backups with external services.
main.backup_path_sync_hint: This folder is the local source and download destination for cloud sync.
main.github_sync_download_hint: Pull Git backups into local storage
main.github_sync_note: Git must be installed and the storage path must be set to a clone of the target remote repository. Authentication credentials are handled entirely by the local Git configuration and are never accessed by OpenGameSave.
main.webdav_password_placeholder: Leave blank when no password is required
main.webdav_password_saved_placeholder: Saved; leave blank to keep unchanged
main.webdav_security_hint: The password is encrypted by the operating system credential store and is never sent to the renderer.
main.webdav_sync_upload_hint: Upload changes incrementally while preserving remote-only backups
main.webdav_sync_download_hint: Verify and merge remote backups into local storage
main.webdav_sync_note: Prefer HTTPS and an app-specific password from your provider. Uploads merge incrementally and do not delete backups that exist only remotely.
